Citymaker.Parking.Name: Parking lot
Citymaker.Parking.Control.StallAngle.Tip: How the spaces sit against the driving lane. Angled spaces are easier to drive into but fit fewer cars.
Citymaker.Parking.StallAngle.90.Tip: Spaces at right angles to the lane. Fits the most cars.
Citymaker.Parking.StallAngle.60.Tip: Slanted spaces, a little easier to drive into.
Citymaker.Parking.StallAngle.45.Tip: Strongly slanted spaces. Easiest to drive into, fits the fewest cars.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Entrances.Tip: Where cars and people get in and out. We put entrances on the nearest street for you; pick a type, click the outline next to a street to add one, right-click one to remove it.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.Entrance.Tip: Cars come in and go out here. Joins the street without changing it.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.Entry.Tip: Cars can only drive in here. Needs a way out somewhere else.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.Exit.Tip: Cars can only drive out here. Needs a way in somewhere else.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.Alley.Tip: Cars come in and go out through a real junction: the kerb opens and the street gets a crossing. Uses a few building plots on the street.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip: A junction where cars can only drive in. Needs a way out somewhere else.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyOut.Tip: A junction where cars can only drive out. Needs a way in somewhere else.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.Footpath.Tip: A path for people only, from the lot to the sidewalk. Does not count as a car entrance.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.BusStop.Tip: A bus stop on the street in front of the lot.
Citymaker.Parking.Marker.ZoningPatch.Tip: Keeps a strip by the street free for buildings at this spot. Width and depth are set under Buildings.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.EdgeZoning.Tip: Leaves a strip next to the street for buildings to grow on. The lot shrinks to make room.
Citymaker.Parking.EdgeZoning.None.Tip: The parking lot uses the whole area.
Citymaker.Parking.EdgeZoning.OneSide.Tip: Buildings along the side with the longest street frontage.
Citymaker.Parking.EdgeZoning.All.Tip: Buildings along every side that faces a street.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.ZoneType.Tip: What may be built there: homes, shops, offices… Automatic uses the city's usual zone.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.ZoningDepth.Ti: How many plots deep the buildings reach, counted from the street (one plot is 8 m, the game allows up to 6).
Citymaker.Parking.Control.ZoningPatchWid: How many plots wide each building plot marker is (one plot is 8 m).
Citymaker.Parking.Control.AsphaltSurface: The surface laid under the lanes and spaces.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Greenery.Tip: Where grass, trees and bushes go instead of pavement.
Citymaker.Parking.Greenery.None.Tip: Paved from edge to edge. No trees.
Citymaker.Parking.Greenery.Edges.Tip: Planting along the outline and at the ends of rows. Rows sit back to back.
Citymaker.Parking.Greenery.Medians.Tip: Also a planted strip between back-to-back rows. Costs some spaces.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.AisleWidth.Tip: Wider lanes give cars more room to turn in.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Setback.Tip: A planted strip between the outline and the first spaces. Tidier, costs spaces.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.RowAngleMode.T: Which way the rows of spaces run.
Citymaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Edge.Tip: Rows run parallel to the longest straight side of the outline.
Citymaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Across.Ti: Rows run at right angles to the longest side.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.RowAngle.Tip: Sets the row angle for the whole lot.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Grading.Tip: On sloped ground every row of spaces is levelled into a terrace (at most 2 % fall), with gentle ramps (at most 8 %) between the terraces. Off: the lot follows the ground as it is.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.SteepGrade: The ground is steep here: levelling the lot moves up to {0} m of earth at its edges.
A driving lane along the whole outline with a row of spaces on the outside. Off uses the full area for rows.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.CrossEvery.Tip: Spaces between short lanes that join neighbouring rows. 0 = none.
How an entrance joins the street outside.
An invisible lane that joins the street without changing it.
Citymaker.Parking.EntranceStyle.Alley.Ti: Builds a small alley into the street. The street gets a real junction and its kerb opens up; it costs a few zoning cells there.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.RowEndPlanting: Ends each row with a patch of grass. Off packs in more cars.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.MedianDepth.Ti: Width of the planted strip between back-to-back rows.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.GreenSurface.T: The surface laid where there is no pavement.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Trees.Tip: Tree types to plant. Empty = a mix of street trees.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Bushes.Tip: Bush types to plant. Empty = a mix of bushes.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.PlantingDensit: How much of the green is planted.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Lanterns.Tip: Places street lights along the rows; lit at night.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.LanternAsset.T: Which street light to use. Automatic picks single and double lights.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.LanternSpacing: Largest gap between two lights along a row.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.EvShare.Tip: Share of spaces with a charger. Chargers stand in the planting behind a pair of spaces, close to the entrance.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.AccessibleShar: Share of wide spaces for disabled drivers, placed closest to the entrance.
Citymaker.Parking.Control.Fee.Tip: What a car pays to park here.
Citymaker.Parking.Reason.NeedsEntrance: Place at least one entrance for cars: a two-way entrance or driveway, or one way in and one way out. Footpaths are for people only.
Citymaker.Parking.Reason.EntryWithoutExi: An entry without an exit - cars could not leave.
Citymaker.Parking.Reason.ExitWithoutEntr: An exit without an entry - place an entry.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.BadShape: This outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges don't cross.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.TooSmall: Too small for a parking lot ({0} m², needs at least {1} m²).
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.TooNarrow: Too narrow for parking rows once the edge margin is taken off. Make the area wider, or the edge margin smaller.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.TooLarge: Too large for one parking lot ({0} m², at most {1} m²). Split it into smaller areas.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.NoEntrance: No entrance for cars yet. Pick an entrance type and click the outline next to a street.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.EntrancesSuggest: Entrances were placed on the nearest road. Move them along the outline if you like.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.EntranceNoPath: Entrance {0} has no straight path to a driving lane. Move the entrance.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.EntranceNoRoad: Entrance {0} has no street outside it. Cars can only use it if a street is built there.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.EntrancesTooClos: Two entrances are on top of each other - one was left out.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.UnreachableStall: {0} spaces could not be reached from an entrance and were left out.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.PerimeterRoadDro: Too narrow for a lane around the lot - built without it.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.SurfaceGaps: {0} m² of pavement or grass is missing: the game cannot display this shape there.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.LayoutFailed: The parking lot could not be planned: {0}
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.NoStalls: No parking space fits here. Try a wider area, narrower spaces or no lane around the lot.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.ReservedSpace: {0} spaces were left out because something else is already planned there.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForCharger: No room for chargers: they need planting behind the spaces.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForAccessi: No room for accessible spaces: they need a row of straight (90°) spaces.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.LotOwnerRejected: The game cannot use this outline as one lot. Smooth out very sharp corners.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.TooManyEntrances: At most {0} entrances per lot - {1} were left out.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.BusStopNoRoad: Bus stop {0} has no street in front of it. Move it next to a street.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningNoStreet: No side of this lot faces a street, so no buildings can grow along it.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningPatchNoStr: This building plot is not next to a street. Move it to a side that faces one.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningStreetTooF: The street is too far away for buildings this deep. Increase the building depth or draw the lot closer to the street.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningLeavesNoRo: The building strips would leave no room for parking - built without them.
Citymaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningTrimmed: {0} building strips were left out because parking runs through them.
